title: The Clock of the Cape Route
author: Bram Pemberton
blurb: Jonah Nystrom, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
